text: dsh-ci-doctor（DSH 插件，适用于可使用后台工具的客户端）：监视 GitHub Actions 中的新失败运行，并在发现失败后通知代理调用诊断工具。它通过 GitHub CLI 读取工作流运行、失败作业和日志，提取归一化错误签名、分类、疑似文件及截取后的日志片段，并汇总成 Markdown 诊断卡。签名账本会记录失败重复出现的次数；配置了 DSH 存储域时可持久保存，否则保存在内存中。适合需要及时发现 CI 回归并快速定位日志线索的开发者。需要已认证的 GitHub CLI，以及 DSH shell 和 tools 服务；后台监视还需要 jobs 服务。

dsh-ci-doctor watches GitHub Actions failures and helps diagnose jobs. It uses the GitHub CLI to summarize logs with error signatures and likely files. A ledger tracks recurring failures, using DSH storage when available. Requires an authenticated CLI and DSH tools, shell, and jobs services.
想让 DSH 持续留意 GitHub Actions 有没有新的失败。
CI 一出错就通知我，并给出对应的运行编号。
帮我把失败作业的日志整理成容易阅读的诊断卡。
从构建日志里找出错误类型和可能涉及的文件。
我想知道这个错误是不是以前的 CI 运行也出现过。
只看某个分支或工作流的 GitHub Actions 失败记录。
Watch GitHub Actions and alert me when a new workflow run fails.
Turn failed CI job logs into a concise diagnosis with likely files.
dsh-ci-doctor 的功能「新失败监视」：启动后台任务定期查询 GitHub Actions 失败运行，首次查询建立历史基线，只在之后发现新失败时通知，并支持分支、工作流筛选及超时结束。
dsh-ci-doctor 的功能「失败日志诊断」：读取指定或最近一次失败运行的作业日志，提取错误签名、类别和疑似文件，并生成 Markdown 诊断卡；可限制日志行数或指定作业。
dsh-ci-doctor 的功能「重复故障记忆」：为归一化错误签名累计出现次数并保存首次、最近出现时间；具备 DSH storageDomain 时持久化，否则使用内存账本。
dsh-ci-doctor 使用前须知：监视 GitHub Actions 新失败运行并启动后台任务。 需要已认证的 GitHub CLI；工具通过 GitHub API 读取运行、作业与日志。
dsh-ci-doctor 使用前须知：读取失败作业日志并生成结构化诊断结果。 需要已认证的 GitHub CLI；工具通过 GitHub API 读取运行、作业与日志。

dsh-ci-doctor 提供工具 ci_watch：Watch a GitHub repository for NEW CI failures (GitHub Actions). Starts a background job that polls via the gh CLI with exponential backoff; when a failure lands, the job completes and you are notified with the run id — call ci_diagnose next. Read-only: never touches the repository or CI state.

dsh-ci-doctor 提供工具 ci_diagnose：Diagnose a failed GitHub Actions run: fetch failed-job logs via the gh CLI, trim them to the error windows, extract normalized error signatures with categories, list suspect files, and recall how often each signature was seen before. Read-only: never touches the repository or CI state.

dsh-ci-doctor README · dsh-ci-doctor：**CI failure, diagnosed before you even open the logs.** `dsh-ci-doctor` watches GitHub Actions for new failures, turns raw job logs into structured findings — normalized error signatures, failure categories, suspect files, trimmed log excerpts — and remembers every signature it has ever seen, so repeat failures are called out on sight. All through two agent tools and the `gh` CLI you already have authenticated.

dsh-ci-doctor README · Usage：Just ask your agent in plain language — it picks the right tool:

- _"Watch CI on this repo and tell me when something fails"_ → starts a `ci_watch` background job.
- _"Why did the nightly build fail?"_ → runs `ci_diagnose` on the latest failed run and hands you the diagnosis card.
- _"Diagnose run 31782742089 on cli/cli"_ → targeted diagnosis of one specific run.

You get a markdown diagnosis card straight in the chat:

```markdown
dsh-ci-doctor README · CI diagnosis: cli/cli run #31782742089：**Conclusion:** failure · [run](https://github.com/cli/cli/actions/runs/31782742089)

dsh-ci-doctor README · Job: Issue Triage (skills-driven)：**Failed steps:** triage
**Signatures:**

- `81a0edf32878` (timeout, first time seen) — server:http_server Session timeout configured…
  **Suspect files:** `script/triage.ts`

<details><summary>Log excerpt</summary>
…
</details>
```

dsh-ci-doctor README · What it does：**1. Watch — the `ci_watch` tool.** Starts a background job that polls for _new_ failed runs (the first poll sets a baseline, so historical red runs never fire the alarm):

```json
{ "repo": "owner/name", "branch": "main", "intervalSeconds": 30, "timeoutMinutes": 60 }
```

dsh-ci-doctor README · What it does：- Streams status lines you can read any time; cancel any time.
- Backs off exponentially on transient errors, gives up after 5 consecutive failures, fails immediately on auth errors.
- On detection it settles with a ready-made next step: `call ci_diagnose with repo="…" runId=…`.
- Watch a repo explicitly, or omit `repo` to watch the current working directory's repository.

**2. Diagnose — the `ci_diagnose` tool.** Point it at a run (or the latest failed run) and it returns the card shown above:

dsh-ci-doctor README · What it does：```json
{ "repo": "owner/name", "runId": 31782742089 }
```

- Error signatures are normalized (timestamps, hex ids, and numbers masked) so the _same_ failure gets the _same_ id across runs.
- Each signature is classified: test / build / lint / typecheck / dependency / network / permission / timeout / infra.
- Suspect files are mined from the log, vendor paths dropped.
- Log excerpts are trimmed to a budget with honest `… (skipped N lines) …` markers — content is never invented.

dsh-ci-doctor README · What it does：**3. The failure-signature ledger.** Every diagnosed signature is remembered — how many times seen, first/last sighting, last repo and run URL. Repeat failures surface as `seen 3×` in the report instead of pretending to be new. The ledger persists as a `ci_doctor` storage unit in the DSH storage directory when the profile provides a storage domain; it is in-memory otherwise.

dsh-ci-doctor README · Read-only by contract：Both tools only ever _read_ GitHub state (via `gh api`). They never push, merge, cancel, rerun, or write anything to your repositories. Every result carries a `repositoryWrites: false` marker, and the package ships an optional invariant companion (`dsh-ci-doctor/invariant`) that fails loudly if a result ever loses that marker on hosts with an `invariants` service.

dsh-ci-doctor README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ci-doctor
```

Prerequisites: the [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com/) authenticated (`gh auth login`) — the plugin reuses that session, there is nothing else to configure.

dsh-ci-doctor README · Configuration：| Option                | Default | Meaning                                   |
| --------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `pollIntervalSeconds` | `30`    | Seconds between watch polls (min 5).      |
| `watchTimeoutMinutes` | `60`    | Wall-clock lifetime of one watch (min 1). |
| `maxLogLines`         | `200`   | Per-job log excerpt budget (min 20).      |
| `ghBin`               | `gh`    | GitHub CLI executable.                    |
| `ledgerEnabled`       | `true`  | Record signatures into the ledger.        |

dsh-ci-doctor README · How it works：The plugin speaks to the host only through documented Cordis seams and imports no `@deepseek-ai/*` package:

- `tools` — registers `ci_watch` / `ci_diagnose` on the real tool runtime.
- `jobs` — `ci_watch` runs as a first-class streaming background job, owned by the calling agent.
- `shell` — every `gh` call goes through the host's guarded, sandboxed execution pipeline.
- `storageDomain` — the signature ledger persists as the `ci_doctor` storage unit.
